body.label: Target
body.html: Enemies in a sphere of radius 1 centered within 5 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, pull each target 1 unit toward the center and deal 1 Force Damage. Independently, the center becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Pull each hit target 1 additional unit.
One hit target is knocked Prone if its movement ends adjacent to another creature or obstacle.

rider.title: Space Thread
rider.html: Gain a Space Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: choose a visible empty space within 2 units as its origin. Measure its Range and area from that space.
